title: Dedicated autoscale initiative: slice definition, cross-team demo cadence, and go-to-market readiness
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Problem: engineering and GTM teams need a repeatable quarterly cadence for slicing the Dedicated Autoscale roadmap into deliverable pieces that align to OKRs, finance constraints (reservation hedging), and an executable go-to-market plan. This ticket defines the initiative slice for Q2, the cross-team demo cadence, acceptance criteria, and the readiness checklist for launch.

Scope: identify the minimal viable feature set for the Dedicated autoscale launch window (policy primitives, fallback tiers, telemetry, and billing signals), coordinate dependencies across Runtime, Console, Billing, and Solutions, and produce a rehearsed demo and customer-facing collateral.

Goals: produce a prioritized slice that delivers measurable SLO improvements for burst scenarios, a validated canary plan, a billing/forecast model for reserved capacity hedging, and a GTM checklist with demo artifacts and customer comms templates.

Out-of-scope: deep kernel/runtime optimizations (tracked as separate ENG spikes), major design system updates to Console unrelated to autoscale UX, and any changes that require a new security approval path beyond standard review.
acceptance_criteria: Defined feature slice doc with scope, owner, and success metrics (latency p95, cost per 1M tokens) published to Confluence
Cross-team alignment confirmed via working group sign-offs (Runtime, Infra, Billing, Console, Solutions, Support)
Canary plan and rollback criteria documented and rehearsed in at least one staging runbook
Cost/forecast simulation model completed with three scenarios (base, surge, catastrophic) and sign-off from Finance
Demo storyboard and rehearsal recorded; GTM collateral (one-pager, release notes, FAQ) ready for PM review
Operational runbook added to Console runbooks and on-call playbook updated with escalation path
comments: 2025-02-13 - Kickoff: initial alignment call with Runtime, Console, Billing. Agreed to limit Q2 slice to policy primitives (min/max pool, burst-to-reservoir), telemetry hooks, and a simple billing signal for surge usage.

2025-02-18 - Spike update: ENG spike (ENG-5023) completed for telemetry hook. Early data shows KV cache hit-rate has biggest impact on p95 under burst; Runtime recommends a lightweight cache-warming preflight for canaries.

2025-02-22 - Trade-off discussion: Finance pushing for stronger reservation hedging assumptions; decision to ship three-tier forecast and postpone a complete hedging product until post-launch (follow-up PM ticket required).

2025-02-27 - Design review: Console UX mockups reviewed. Design requested to reduce button density on the autoscale policy modal and add an 'audit preview' step. PM accepted with follow-up DES-712 to iterate.
2025-03-01 - Security review: SSO and audit logging path validated; no additional security approval required. Security comments attached (see link to security ticket).
2025-03-02 - Demo cadence: Weekly working group demos scheduled on Tuesdays. First public rehearsal slated for 2025-04-21. Ops to run a dry-run with synthetic surge and validate rollback in staging.
